description: This file defines the HiringManagerAPI class which serves as an API endpoint for retrieving a list of available hiring managers (employees) within the recruitment module of OrangeHRM. It incorporates methods for listing employees accessible to the current user with filtering, sorting, and pagination, and adheres to the application's API structure and documentation standards.

classes.name: HiringManagerAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for fetching a list of hiring managers (employees) accessible by the current user within the recruitment module.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list hiring managers, filtering employees based on accessible vacancy IDs and applying sorting and pagination parameters.
